game: Jack In The Box / Jumping Jack

sections.Profile:
The "Jack in the Box" pinball machine, produced by Gottlieb in February 1973, is an electro-mechanical game designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison. This four-player game features a circus/carnival theme, complete with vibrant and playful artwork.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1973
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Good Times, Dual Theme, Circus, Clowns, Original Theme, 1970s
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Gordon Morison
- Design: Ed Krynski
sections.Editions:
- Jack In The Box: 8,300 made, released 1973-02-01, model number 339
- Jumping Jack: 4,975 made, released 1973-05-01, model number 340
